summary: Full E2E test of São José Material de Construção (loja + admin). Backend: 24/24 pytest passing covering auth, catalog, product detail, shipping (local/remote/free/invalid), Stripe session creation, WhatsApp order, payment status, admin CRUD/stats/orders and auth guards. Frontend Playwright: home loads, category nav works (3 products in cimento-argamassa), search returns results, product detail with CEP shipping calc works, WhatsApp buy button present, add-to-cart works (badge shows 1), 6 institutional pages return 200, footer has CNPJ 60.219.119/0001-81 and razão social, checkout form + shipping calc + Stripe redirect to https://checkout.stripe.com/... works, WhatsApp order works. Admin login → dashboard → products create (via Select dropdown) → new product appears in list, orders page lists paid+novo orders. All critical happy paths pass.

issues: Console warning: empty string passed to when product.images is empty; fileUrl('') returns '' — should render placeholder or omit src to avoid full-page reload warning

action_items: Set document <title> and meta description in /app/frontend/public/index.html (Google Ads requires descriptive title/meta)
Fix fileUrl to return a placeholder image or make not render when src is empty (silences console warning and avoids extra page fetch)
Add <DialogDescription> inside AdminProducts DialogContent for a11y
critical_code_review_comments: server.py OK: uses uuid for id, excludes _id from responses, proper HTTP codes, Pydantic validation, JWT bearer auth. Good.
seed() is idempotent for admin (updates hash if password changed) — matches auth playbook.
Stripe integration uses env-based key; session BRL currency correct; success/cancel URLs derived from origin_url. Good.
Product delete is soft-delete (active=false) which is correct (keeps order references intact).
Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via api client; token stored as 'sj_token' in localStorage per spec.
Minor: no rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (spec says JWT, not the strict playbook cookie flow; acceptable for MVP but flag for prod).
Minor: search regex isn't escaped — user input like '.*' works but special regex chars from search could be an issue; consider re.escape server-side.
